questions.en: What is the name of the famous philosopher and economic theorist whose birth certificate was signed in Trier in 1818 by an ancestor of Günther Jauch?

timeline.labelEn: Life of Karl Marx, philosopher and economist, born in Trier
timeline.labelDe: Leben von Karl Marx, Philosoph und Ökonom, geboren in Trier

questions.cardDe: In welchem Land beendete F. Scott Fitzgerald die Arbeit an seinem Buch Der große Gatsby?
questions.de: In welchem Land beendete F. Scott Fitzgerald die Arbeit an seinem Buch Der große Gatsby?
questions.en: In which country did F. Scott Fitzgerald finish work on his book The Great Gatsby?

timeline.labelEn: F. Scott Fitzgerald completes the draft of The Great Gatsby on the French Riviera
timeline.labelDe: F. Scott Fitzgerald stellt an der Côte d’Azur den Entwurf von Der große Gatsby fertig

questions.notes: Fitzgerald completed the draft at Saint-Raphaël on the French Riviera in 1924; strictly, he made the final revisions over the winter in Rome and submitted the final version in February 1925, so 'Italy' is defensible too.
